says: Now that the page draws only tezgah windows, the polite line for an ended tile names the window row's process name and its full tile id, such as checklist:1 in tile_<26 characters> ended (crashed), where the tile guideline says tracker in t2 ended and the tile's own name is checklist, t1.
proof: spoken.ts:39 builds `${tile.name} in ${tile.id} ended (...)` from the window's row, whose name is the process tezgah's tile shows and whose id is tezgah's TileId; Layout.tsx:31 tileName gives the tile as `checklist, t1`; docs/direction/tile-guidelines.md:288 gives the polite words as `tracker in t2 ended`. spoken.test.ts asks for the row's name and id, so the law holds the long form.
cost: A screen reader user hears a process name and a long id they never see on screen, not the tile's own short name; not heard on a real screen reader.
